caveat: Every historical figure in B9's source document is the seats' recollection, not a measurement. Only the race footnote below is measured, and it names its source.
return_basis_note: Adj Close, so dividends are included; a price-return reading of the same window would be lower by the yield, which matters most on VGK
commodities_note: A separate context list, never raced (amendment 1): comparing an equity index's recovery with gold's is a comparison of two different things on one axis.

cross_reads.name: USD/JPY, 5 days
cross_reads.flag: past −3%, which is the CARRY_UNWIND overlay's own trigger

overnight.label: reacting to the prior US close · context, not a forecast

leadership_change.basis: the ratio closed past its 200-day twice in a row and the 50-day slope agrees; a flicker back inside resets it

new_leader_panel.title: A NEW LEADER IS REAL IF
new_leader_panel.note: Market-neutral: the same rules apply to every market, the US included. The tool must be as loud when SPY reclaims first as when any other market does.
confirms: the 12-month ratio makes a higher high
refutes: new USD lows after SPY bottoms
rallies stall at the ratio's 200-day, which is a bear-market rally

meltdown.arms_at: SPY closes 10% or more below its 252-day high
meltdown.reason_not_armed: SPY is [MOCK 3.1%] below its 252-day high, inside the 10% arming level

coupling.basis: the 20-day correlation of EEM and SPY daily returns is [MOCK 0.62] and DXY is [MOCK falling]

meltdown.push_note: One phone push when meltdown mode arms, then a weekly race summary while it stays armed. Nothing is sent from this mock.

recovery_race.title: RECOVERY RACE
recovery_race.universe_note: Equity only (amendment 1): the seven country and regional ETFs plus SPY and QQQ.
recovery_race.column_authority_note: The columns are in order of what history supports: the first is the measure that held up, the last is the one that did not.
recovery_race.anchor_note: The anchor is SPY's lowest close of the last 63 sessions, at least 10 sessions old. Not armed in this mock, so every rank here is illustrative.
recovery_race.footnote: US selloffs since 2003 (9 episodes; equity ETFs; USD total return; QUERY 2026-10-18): the 'gained most' leader still led SPY 6 months later in 8 of 9, 'fell least' in 2 of 9. History, not a forecast.

labels.note: A threshold whose frequency is not stated is a threshold nobody can calibrate against. Today is excluded from the 60 sessions it is scored against: included, a large move inflates its own denominator and scores lower than it should.
